description: Store all Plaid liability fields during sync, calculate statement coverage from checking balances, surface coverage data across accounts/dashboard/budget pages, and enrich LLM context with liability information.

timing.gatingCondition: Feature 11 (split liability onboarding) ships first so credit cards are onboarded intentionally.

principles: Coverage base is checking accounts only — needing savings to cover cards is crazy town
Statement balance is the obligation, not current balance (falls back to current if no statement yet)
All liability fields nullable — gracefully handle sparse Plaid responses
Coverage data enriches LLM context for smarter financial advice

techStack.database: PostgreSQL with NUMERIC(12,2) and JSONB columns
techStack.testing: node:test integration tests against live database

userStories.title: Store all Plaid liability fields during sync
acceptanceCriteria: Migration adds 8 liability columns to accounts table
Sync stores statement_balance, due_date, minimum_payment, APR data, overdue status
All fields nullable — no failures on sparse Plaid responses
userStories.testStrategy: Integration test verifying liability fields persist after sync upsert.

userStories.title: Coverage calculator and API endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/accounts/coverage returns checking_total, obligation_total, ratio, status, card breakdown
Status tiers: clear/healthy/warning/danger based on configurable threshold
Cards ordered by due date ascending
Obligation falls back to current_balance when no statement balance
userStories.testStrategy: Integration tests for healthy/warning/danger/clear scenarios plus fallback behavior.

userStories.title: Frontend coverage surfaces on 3 pages
acceptanceCriteria: Accounts page: coverage banner with per-card breakdown and due dates
Budget: obligations card with statement total and coverage ratio
Credit account cards show statement balance, due date, minimum payment
userStories.testStrategy: Manual UI verification on all three pages.

userStories.title: LLM context enrichment with liability coverage
acceptanceCriteria: All four context assemblers include liability_coverage block
Financial snapshot includes checking_balance, statement_obligations, coverage_ratio
Account objects in query/snapshot contexts include statement_balance and due_date for credit accounts
userStories.testStrategy: Manual verification via Ask Pulse queries about credit card coverage.

medium: Plaid may return sparse liability data for some institutions — all fields are nullable to handle this
low: Coverage calculation assumes statement_balance is the obligation — may not match exact payment for zero-balance-transfer accounts

preFlightChecklist: Feature 11 ships first (liability onboarding separated from default flow)
At least one credit card linked via liability-aware onboarding to verify data flows end-to-end
